description.en:
Shows a designed on-screen notification whenever an external "Farm Manager" process running on the same PC (for example, a Claude Code automation skill) sends one.
The mod watches a small bridge file on disk and, the moment a message appears, draws a card: a rounded, severity-coloured panel (green / blue / amber / red) with a farm glyph, a title, the in-game time it arrived, and word-wrapped body text. Recent cards stack, so a new one arrives with its context instead of replacing it.
If the panel cannot be drawn for any reason, the mod falls back to the game's own native notification rather than going silent.
Nothing else is touched: no gameplay system is modified and the game's save files are never written. Client-side only, safe for singleplayer and multiplayer.
The panel has two modes, toggled with Ctrl+Period (rebindable in Controls as "AIFM: toggle panel"). ON, the default, keeps the panel on screen: header, cards and reply bar stay up and cards wait until you answer or dismiss them. OFF turns it back into a transient notifier where each card fades out on its own. Unanswered cards are kept either way - they return when the panel comes back on, even after a restart.
Cards that offer actions show clickable buttons (acknowledge, yes/no, dismiss). Bring up the mouse cursor with Ctrl+Comma (rebindable in Controls as "AIFM: toggle cursor") - this works on foot or in a vehicle - then click, drag or scroll the panel. Press again to lower the cursor. On foot the mouse wheel may also zoom the camera while the cursor is over the panel; dragging the scrollbar scrolls with no camera movement. (If the cursor is already up another way, for example AutoDrive's middle mouse button or Courseplay's right mouse button, that works too.) The reply bar at the panel's bottom opens a text box for a free-text message. Your answers are written to replies.xml in this savegame's own folder, modSettings/FS25_AIFarmManager25/<savegame>/, for the Farm Manager process to read. Without a cursor on screen the mod is a passive notifier.
Ctrl+Alt+Period (rebindable in Controls as "AIFM: settings") opens the game menu, on foot or in a vehicle, and tries to select the Farm Manager page; if the menu opens on another page, click the Farm Manager tab. The page has Farm, Fields, Productions, Messages and Settings tabs. The Settings tab holds the panel options (the panel on or off, its size, width, text size and card background, how long messages linger, the longest a card may live, how many messages are kept, the lowest severity shown, and a reset for the panel's position).
The bridge is notify.xml in this savegame's folder, modSettings/FS25_AIFarmManager25/<savegame>/ (each savegame has its own bridge, cards and replies). Optional: modSettings/FS25_AIFarmManager25/settings.xml seeds the panel's position, width, text size and background opacity; the panel's own saved state (state.xml, same folder) takes precedence once it exists.
